name: tree
title: Tree
description: A file tree whose folders open on a height spring as the chevron turns, both interruptible. One selection glides between rows, guides mark each level, and keys follow WAI-ARIA.
docs: Import Tree and TreeNode from components/eased/tree/tree. Give it a max height and it scrolls with edge fades. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
